mapper.select: SELECT id, question_id, generator_language, generator_object_key, manifest_object_key, primary_standard_language, status, benchmark_repeat_times, margin_multiplier, min_extra_ms, round_to_ms FROM tb_judge_problem_config WHERE id = #{configId}

SELECT id, config_id, question_id, language, object_key, object_hash, primary_solution, benchmark_status, p95_time_ms, max_time_ms, peak_memory_kb, suggested_time_limit_ms, benchmark_message FROM tb_judge_standard_solution WHERE config_id = #{configId} ORDER BY language

SELECT tc.id, tc.config_id, tc.question_id, tc.case_no, tc.category, tc.input_object_key, tc.input_object_hash, tc.output_object_key, tc.output_object_hash, tc.weight, tc.hidden, tc.sample FROM tb_judge_test_case tc JOIN tb_judge_problem_config cfg ON cfg.id = tc.config_id WHERE tc.question_id = #{questionId} AND cfg.status = 'READY' ORDER BY tc.case_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_judge_standard_solution SET benchmark_status = #{status}, p95_time_ms = #{p95TimeMs}, max_time_ms = #{maxTimeMs}, peak_memory_kb = #{peakMemoryKb}, suggested_time_limit_ms = #{suggestedTimeLimitMs}, benchmark_message = #{message} WHERE id = #{solutionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, config_id, question_id, case_no, category, input_object_key, input_object_hash, output_object_key, output_object_hash, weight, hidden, sample FROM tb_judge_test_case WHERE config_id = #{configId} ORDER BY case_no
